Bob is going to make some orange paint. He needs to mix red paint, 
yellow paint and white paint in the ratio 5 : 4 : 1 
Bob wants to make 750 m l of orange paint. 
Bob has:

300 m l of yellow paint
200 m l of white paint

the orange paint?

(3 marks)
